error[ZBX-E0317]: a --sysctl net.* key with --net host
  cause  with --net host the container shares the host's network namespace, so
         net.core.somaxconn would change the host
  fix    drop --net host, so the container has a network of its own
  more   zbx explain E0317 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0317.html
